political_covariates.interpretation: Fixed 118th-Senate actor covariates supplied in nodes.csv.

conditional_prediction.aggregation: L1=mean(p); L1g=exp(mean(log(p))); L2=product(p) of single-dyad conditional-pseudolikelihood scores; metrics use log_L2 as a monotone numerically stable representation

metrics.scope: ranking only: ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision@k, recall@k
metrics.excluded: No accuracy, F1, MCC, log loss, or native-event probability claim is made.

limitations: Every model is fit to one split's observed projection only; full-network coefficients are not reused.
L1, L1g, and L2 describe conditional dyadic graph-footprint completion, not a probability of a recorded native email event.
L2 is a product of single-dyad conditional-pseudolikelihood scores. It is not the matched-marginal L2 or L3-F required for the plan's joint conditional ERGM simulation.
Model fit, conditional prediction, and aggregation failures remain visible in model_status.csv.
